title: rubus glandulosus pallidus
intro: Rubus glandulosus pallidus, commonly known as the Himalayan raspberry, is a species of bramble found in the Himalayan region. It has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and alleviating symptoms of fever, cough, and diarrhea. The therapeutic actions of Rubus glandulosus pallidus are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antipyretic properties, which are derived from its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and ascorbic acid. These constituents contribute to the plant's antioxidant and antimicrobial activities, making it a valuable resource for natural medicine.
